text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for Bamboo Memory
for a while,
but she hasn't shown up for
training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
TRAINER! I'M SO SORRY! I didn't mean
to be
late!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I got completely caught up watching this
red-hot
show... But I'll make up for it! A
hundred laps
should be appropriate!
Plus a hundred-page
apology letter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
As part of the disciplinary committee,
I'm
supposed to be watching for
latecomers! And
despite that, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... You're so understanding! That
makes me
even more embarrassed!
You've left me with no
choice...
choice_data_list: その気持ちだけで充分だ
その気持ちだけで充分だよ
choice_data_list_en: The thought alone is more than enough.
Just the thought is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll do a thousand laps around the track! And write a thousand-page apology letter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seems truly remorseful,
so I tell
her not to beat herself up too
much.
